spec.name: National Festival of Dakka and Rhythms
spec.description: National festival in Taroudant celebrating dakka, a collective percussion and chant art historically tied to craftsmen's guilds, famous in its Roudani (Taroudant) and Marrakchi forms. Researchers trace the origins of the art to Taroudant itself.

editions.notes: Rescheduled from the usual period due to the COVID-19 pandemic
